C-TAB-CLOSE-OWNERSHIP.IntentSummary: Execute the owner's delegated GRACE fix: reproduce document ownership failures, repair the renderer activation boundary, verify with synthetic fixtures, and prepare a local commit for owner release-train review.
C-TAB-CLOSE-OWNERSHIP.ApprovalBasis: Owner explicitly requested this session to finish the GRACE fix and privacy checks before asking for release-train approval.

MustContain.Text: typing belongs only to the remaining document

T-001.Title: Demonstrate activation and delayed-event ownership failures

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Regressions fail on the baseline, using synthetic tab identities/content; private native evidence remains outside the public worktree.

T-002.Title: Enforce rendered-document ownership and recover missed activation

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Cross-tab events are ignored, current-tab activation recovers its own state, and stale rendered changes do not update another document.

T-003.Title: Verify realistic close/switch behavior and privacy

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Synthetic structured document close/edit scenarios pass in Chromium, WebKit and an isolated native surface; exact staged privacy and governance checks pass without original documents or raw captures.

Verification.Command: npx playwright test tests/e2e/session-restore.spec.ts tests/e2e/source-code-mode.spec.ts tests/e2e/split-view.spec.ts --project=chromium --project=webkit-session

T-004.Title: Commit the verified repair locally and request owner release-train admission

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Normal safety hooks review the exact candidate; a concise private acceptance note describes the fix, verification and residual limits. No push or release admission is performed.
